paper.title_en: Analogue Schwinger Pair Production in Acoustic Black Holes
paper.abstract_en: We show that an analogue Schwinger pair production can be realized in Reissner-Nordstr{ö}m-like acoustic black holes constructed from a Bose-Einstein condensate subject to a synthetic vector potential. Upon Kaluza-Klein reduction of the five-dimensional acoustic geometry, the higher-dimensional phonon modes appear as effectively charged phonons in the resulting four-dimensional spacetime, in which the electric field experienced by the charged phonons arises from the component of the synthetic vector potential along the compactified direction. Then by appropriately choosing the background flow velocity and the synthetic vector potential, the reduced acoustic metric can take the form of a Reissner-Nordstr{ö}m-like black hole. From this metric we obtain the mean number of spontaneously produced phonon pairs in both the extremal and near extremal cases, and show that in the extremal limit this mean number takes the form of the Schwinger formula. Moreover, charged-phonon pair production not only admits the same effective thermal interpretation as Schwinger pair production of real charged particles, but can also be interpreted as the analogue Hawking radiation and superradiance from the five-dimensional perspective. Finally, we make estimates of pair production using experimental parameters in Bose-Einstein condensate, providing theoretical guidance for future laboratory detection.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文将模拟 Schwinger 对产生与声学黑洞、Kaluza-Klein 约化及合成规范场结合，涉及霍金辐射与超辐射的类比解释，理论深度较好且给出实验参数估计，与黑洞热力学和类比引力方向高度相关，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 声学黑洞中的模拟 Schwinger 对产生
decision.abstract_zh: 我们证明，可以在由受合成矢量势作用的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体构造的、类 Reissner-Nordstr{ö}m 声学黑洞中实现模拟 Schwinger 对产生。对五维声学几何进行 Kaluza-Klein 约化后，高维声子模式在所得四维时空中表现为有效带电声子，其中带电声子所感受到的电场来自合成矢量势沿紧致化方向的分量。随后，通过适当选择背景流速和合成矢量势，约化后的声学度规可以取类 Reissner-Nordstr{ö}m 黑洞的形式。由该度规，我们得到了在极端情形与近极端情形下自发产生的声子对的平均数目，并证明在极端极限下该平均数目取 Schwinger 公式的形式。此外，带电声子对产生不仅与真实带电粒子的 Schwinger 对产生具有相同的有效热解释，还可以从五维视角解释为模拟霍金辐射与超辐射。最后，我们使用玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中的实验参数对对产生进行了估计，为未来实验室探测提供了理论指导。
